assemblyAIReview.trigger: AssemblyAI product announcement and owner-requested service review.
assemblyAIReview.changes: STT-3.7 is available for recordings. Adopted for new jobs at the same published base price: $0.21/audio hour plus $0.02 diarization. The newsletter Sync API discount applies to a different API.
assemblyAIReview.evidence: Vendor-reported benchmarks: with the new diarization system, Universal-3.5 → STT-3.7 cpWER 26.8% → 23.5%, DER 10.5% → 9.4%. Clean-English WER slightly worsens (5.0% → 5.2%). No independent head-to-head or local reprocessing evaluation established.
assemblyAIReview.rationale: Expected improvement in speaker attribution at unchanged published unit cost. Explicit disfluencies:false retains cleaned text.
assemblyAIReview.followUp: PR #667 merged and production deployment verified 2026-11-20. Existing jobs retain their saved model; completed recordings were not reprocessed. Observe quality, returned model, and billed rate on the next naturally requested transcription.
